book.name: 2 Korin
book.title: Rau Ite Inim Ru To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Korin 2 Korin—2 Corinthians

content: Paulus iveivei pa yes Korin pa mbaŋooŋa kaaromŋa
You naghaze nagham ŋgar to borouŋa ris. Vena, irau ayok payou?

Aghita. You nasia gham pa Krisi wa. Tovenen ŋgar tiou iyaryaaŋ naghaze le ŋgar tiam isob iŋgalaaŋ moghon, ve naghur gham ala toni, animale liva paghu to tighuri ila to tamoot, leso yesuru tivai. Pasa, Maaron ŋgar toni iyaryaaŋ ighaze tamtoghon toni tighur lolodi ve ŋgar todi isob ila pani moghon. Ep 5:27; Kol 1:28; Syg 14:4

Aazne, yam ataghon ŋgar ŋgalaaŋa ve aghur lolomim isob iŋarua Krisi. Eemoghon namatughez: Pale tamtoghon pida tighamun ŋgar tiam, inimale muuŋ moot igham kaarom pa Eva ve itombaana, ghoro apul ŋgar tonanan. Mbnp 3:1+; 2Pe 3:17

Pasa, you nawatag: Tamtoghon pida tilat tineep toman gham, ve saveeŋ to tivovotia pa Yesu, nene raraate inimale saveeŋ to muuŋ yei nisavia payam ne maau. Ve avuvu to yes tighaze yam aghami, nene raraate inimale Maaron Avuvu to muuŋ aghami ne maau. Ve varu poia to tivovotia payam ne paam, nene raraate inimale varu poia to yei nisavia payam ve aghur ila ne maau. Eemoghon yam agham di toman lolomim poia, ve apul di tigham uraat todi tonanan, ve aghur ila saveeŋ todi. Ga 1:6+
Alooŋ. Mbaŋooŋa pida to yam aghita di aghaze izadi tintina, yes tilib payou maau. Sa ŋgar to yes tighami, you naghami paam. 1Kor 15:10; 2Kor 12:11; Ga 2:6+

Onoon, you ŋgeu to savsaveeŋ nanimale yes maau. Eemoghon ŋgar to Maaron, you nambool pani maau. Sawa naol, ŋgar naol to nagham di ne, tipatooŋ ghou ila matamim tighaze you naghazooŋ pa Maaron ŋgar toni. 1Kor 1:17, 2:1,13; Ep 3:4

Yam awatag: Sawa to navotia varu poia to Maaron payam, natatan taug, ve nagham uraat payam sorok. Nayok pa agham leg atia maau. You nataghon ataam tovene pa napakur gham. Laak, yam aghita vena? You nasosor? 1Kor 9:12+
Sawa tonenen, you naneep ila lupuuŋ pida to Krisi nimadi. Ulaaŋ to tigham payou, nene iuul ghou ve nagham uraat payam. Ŋgar tonenen, nene inimale you nayub mbeb todi, leso nagham payam.

Sawa to itiŋa tanepneep ve mbolaaŋ igham ghou, you naghason gham pa ulaaŋ eta maau. Pasa, toŋvetaz pida to Masedonia tinim, ve tiuul ghou pa mbeb to nambool pani. Ve lolog pa nagham pataŋani eta payam maau. Tauto nayai ghou, ve naghason gham pa ulaaŋ eta maau. Ve aazne ve itaghoni ila paam, pale nataghon ŋgar raraate moghon. 2Kor 12:13; Pil 4:15+; 1Tes 2:9

Alooŋ. Saveeŋ onoon to Krisi ineep tiou, ve ye tau ighita ghou ve nasavia saveeŋ tonene. Yam tamtoghon to Akaia, tiam eta irau igham ghou napul ataam to nataghoni pa uraat tiou ne maau. Pasa, ataam tonene to igham ghou tinig iza ve napakur ghou pani.
Vena, yam aghaze you lolog payam maau, tauto nataghon ataam tovene? Maaron iwatag: You lolog payam kat.

Tovenen irau nayok payam pa auul ghou ne maau. Ataam to nataghoni pa uraat tiou, nene pale inepneep tovene. Pasa, naghaze napoon ataam pa yes to tipapait taudi izadi tighaze yes raratedi tinimale yei.
Ŋgar to mbaŋooŋa kaaromŋa tighamghami
Ndiran tonowen, tigham taudi tinimale mbaŋooŋa to Krisi. Eemoghon yes mbaŋooŋa to Krisi maau! Tigham kaarom. Mt 7:15+; Mbaŋ 20:29+; 2Kor 2:17
Ve iit irau ruŋaad iza pa kaarom todi tonowen maau. Pasa, Sadan paam irau igham tau inimale aŋela to ipatooŋ ghazooŋa to Maaron, leso itombaan ghiit. Ga 1:8
Tovenen mbesooŋa toni paam, irau tigham taudi tinimale ndiran to titaghon ŋgar deŋia. Eemoghon ruŋaad iza padi malep. Muri, Maaron pale ighur atia iŋarua di pa ŋgar todi.
Pataŋani naol to Paulus imbaad di, tauto tipatooŋa tighaze ye mbaŋooŋa to Krisi

You nasaav wa. Naghaze nasavia saveeŋ ris inimale borouŋa. Eemoghon tiam eta ighita ghou nanimale borou malep. Ve ighaze aghita ghou nanimale borou, nene poia! Apul ghou ve nagham ŋgar to borouŋa, ve napait taug izag ris.
You nawatag: Saveeŋ to naghaze nasavia pa napait taug, nene itaghon ŋgar to Tiina toit maau. Saveeŋ to naghaze nasavia, nene inimale saveeŋ to yes borouŋa to ledi ŋgar maau.
Ve tambaŋa. Pasa, tamtoghon katindi to yamŋa anepneep, yes titaghon ŋgar to taan ve tipapait taudi izadi. Tovenen you paam, anag naghaze napait taug.
Aa yam Korin, yam araua kat pa ŋgar! Tauto yes to ledi ŋgar maau tinimale borouŋa, yam lolomim poia padi, ve lolomim pa loŋaaŋ saveeŋ todi!

Ve tonene moghon maau. Pasa, ighaze tamtoghon eta itatan gham ve izoorndug payam pa ataghon ŋgar toni moghon, ma iyou mbeb tiam tisob tinim le, ma igham mbeb tiam dige ee moghon, ma ipait tau, ma ipambar gham ve ipamayaŋin gham, yam ayok pani moghon, ve apuli ighamgham tovene.

Ndiran tonanan tilib payei kat! Tigham ghei mayamai. Pasa, ŋgar to tighamghami, yei irau nitaghoni maau. Yo, naghaze naseeŋ saveeŋ tiou borou tonene. Pasa, ndiran pida to tineep toman gham, mayadi maau ve tipapait taudi izadi. Tovenen you pale nataghon ŋgar todi ve napait taug izag paam! 2Kor 10:10
Vena, ndiran tonanan yes Hibrua? You paam to Hibru. Ve yes to Israel? You paam to Israel. Ve yes tivot ila to Abaram? You paam navot ila to Abaram.

Ve yes mbesooŋa to Krisi? You paam, mbesooŋa toni. Eemoghon you nalib padi. Aliŋag tonene, you nawatag, nene saveeŋ to borouŋa. Eemoghon tambaŋa! You narab taug pa uraat to Krisi le nalib padi. Ve tilos ghou le nasami pae katindi. Sawa naol, tighur ghou nalooŋ nala ruum to yabyabuuŋ. Ve moghon moghon, naghita naghaze sawa tiou to mateeŋ inim igharau. Pataŋani naol to nambaad di, nene nalib pa ndiran tonanan. 1Kor 4:9+; 2Kor 4:11, 6:4+
Daba to yes Yuda tilos ghou pa ravraav pa liim wa. Ve sawa eŋaeŋa to tilos ghou, tilos ghou pa tamoot ee saaŋgul liim ve paaŋ (39).

Yes Roma tigham toon ve tilos ghou pae tol wa. Ve sawa eez, ival tikor yaam ve tirab matin ghou. Sawa tol, you naza waaŋ ve niraav nila le waaŋ imbiriis ila te pogho. Ve sawa eez, namoghan ila te pogho pa mboŋ eez, ve ndag eez. Mbaŋ 14:19, 16:22+, 27:41

Sawa naol to nalaghlaagh, pataŋani naol tiŋarua ghou ve rismoghon tone namaat. Yawaaŋa ivot toman tapiri le rismoghon izugua ghou nalaleg. Moghon moghon yubyubŋa, ve yes Yuda to yeiŋa ndug ee moghon, ve yes to Yuda maau ne paam tizuaria di tighaze tiwaghamun ghou. Tovenen ighaze naneep ila ndug tintina, ma nalaghlaagh izi ndug balim, ma naza waaŋ ve naraav ila te pogho, nene pataŋani ighamgham ghou tovene. Ve tamtoghon to titoom ve tigham taudi tinimale toŋvetaz to Krisi, yes tigham pataŋani tiina payou paam. Mbaŋ 9:23, 13:50, 20:3, 23:12+

Moghon moghon, you narabrab taug pa uraat, ve nagheen pooi maau. Ve sawa naol, naneep sami, ve murun ghou ve pitool ghou. Ag aniiŋ maau. Ve moŋeŋaaŋ ighamgham ghou pasa, leg nonogiiŋa poia eta to nandud ghou pani maau. Mbaŋ 20:31; 2Kor 6:5
Pataŋani naol tonowen, to tinig moghon. Ve mbeb ite paam ighamgham pataŋani payou. Pasa, sawa isob, you naghamgham ŋgar naol pa lupuuŋ tisob to Krisi, ve lolog imbumbu padi.
Ighaze tamtoghon eta ghurla toni iyaryaaŋ maau, nene igham ghou nayamaan taug naghaze tapirig isob. Ve ighaze tiweu toit eta ve igham sosor, nene igham ghou ateg yabyab kat.

Ighaze ŋgar tiam iyaryaaŋ aghaze napait taug, nene poia. You pale nataghon ŋgar tiam. Eemoghon sawa to napait ghou, you pale nasavia mbeb pida to tipatooŋ ghou tighaze you tapirig imbool. 2Kor 12:5,9+
Tiina toit Yesu Krisi Tama Maaron, iit irau tapait iza irau sawa isob. Ye iwatag: Saveeŋ tiou tonene, kaarom maau. Onoon moghon. Ro 1:9+; 2Kor 1:23
Sawa to naneep izi ndug tiina Damaskus, gavana to kinik Aretas ighuri inim ŋginiiŋ pa ndug tonowen, ye ighur ndaaba pida pa tiŋgin ataam to ndug, leso tikis ghou.

Eemoghon nditag pida tizeev ghou nala nakaral tiina lolo, ve tigham ghou nila pa marai saambu to ineep ila didiiŋ tiina to ndug dige, ve titug ghou nazi nala. Tauto ye ikis ghou maau, ve naghau nala. Mbaŋ 9:23+

footnotes.text: Saveeŋ ‘Hibrua’ ve ‘Israela,’ pughudi raraate maau. Hibrua, nene Abaram papaghu toni. Ve saveeŋ ‘Israela’, nene iŋarua ghurla todi. Yes to Maaron igham di tinim le, ve titaghon tutuuŋ toni, tiwaat taudi tighaze yes Israela. Ve ndug ndug tiwaat di tighaze ‘Yuda.’
Tutuuŋ to Mose isaav tovene: Ighaze tilos tamtoghon eta, yes irau tilosi pa tamoot ru (40) ve izi. Irau timalaaŋ pa 40 ve izala maau. Tovenen sawa to yes Yuda tilos Paulus, tiŋgal mata kat.
